name: ttt-website
description: Talk The Taste - Dubai Creative Agency

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:forms && npm run prepare:public
scripts.build:js: terser js/transitions.js -c -m -o js/transitions.min.js && terser js/language-switcher.js -c -m -o js/language-switcher.min.js && terser js/conversion.js -c -m -o js/conversion.min.js
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name talkthetaste
